story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: A Call to Responsibility
story_library.children_narration: Surah Al-Muddaththir begins with a call to rise and warn. It teaches about sincerity, personal responsibility, and not becoming proud of one's efforts. The surah also includes serious warnings about rejecting truth and neglecting those in need.

world_idea.title: The Dawn of Responsibility
world_idea.description: Explore a landscape moving from darkness to daylight and complete activities about keeping shared spaces clean, caring for others, and acting sincerely.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
